subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should the Wear companion require matched Phone/Watch releases, or must it support staggered app updates with capability-gated controls and a migration-safe owner for the new persisted settings?
rationale: The patch changes the companion protocol and adds persistent behavior, so the acceptable upgrade contract and durable state owner are product compatibility decisions rather than choices that can be inferred safely from the branch alone.

options.title: Support independent upgrades
options.body: Add a capability/version handshake, hide or degrade unsupported controls on an older paired Phone, and move the two new settings to an approved migration-safe state owner.

options.title: Declare matched versions required
options.body: Document and enforce a paired-version minimum before enabling the restored controls, with an explicit user-facing recovery path for mixed versions.

options.title: Pause the expanded controls
options.body: Land only the already compatible companion behavior until maintainers choose the long-term protocol and persistence contract.

recommendation.title: Support independent upgrades
recommendation.body: Add a capability/version handshake, hide or degrade unsupported controls on an older paired Phone, and move the two new settings to an approved migration-safe state owner.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is the only evidence-backed Android/Wear participant in the supplied review material and can clarify the intended compatibility model while a repository owner makes the final contract decision.
